summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Bank of Montreal (BMO) containing its unaudited interim consolidated financial statements and management's discussion and analysis for the quarterly period ended April 30, 2026. It is a routine earnings report, not a special-situations filing. The filing includes standard financial disclosures under IFRS, segment information, and regulatory capital data. As a Canadian issuer, the 6-K serves as the equivalent of a domestic quarterly report on Form 10-Q. No special corporate events are described; no transactional terms, catalysts, or structural changes are present.
